title: Catalogue: adding an archive that is already installed makes a duplicate
description: A ZIM installed without a catalogue link (catalogEntryId null) is not recognised when its catalogue entry or a pack is added, so the same file is downloaded and installed again. Seen on 2026-11-15 with wikipedia_en_knots_maxi (same sha256 and ZIM uuid, two collections). Match by ZIM uuid or checksum and adopt the existing collection instead.

title: Reader: try in-archive PDFs and saving links on iOS Safari and Firefox
description: The fix for web-archive books was checked in Chromium and against a simulated archive script, not on a phone browser.

title: Network shares: try with a real NAS, and on Linux and Docker
description: Mounting was proven against a stand-in SMB server on macOS. Untried: a real NAS with real credentials, the generated Linux fstab steps, NFS, the generated Compose lines with the real image, IPv6 addresses.

title: Test on browsers and devices not yet tried
description: Firefox, Safari, real phones; notes table column resizing; maps locate-me with a real position; members' view of Maps.
close_reason: Superseded by the narrower follow-ups filed on 2026-11-15

description: Chunking, optional local embeddings, vector index, semantic and hybrid search, citations, index management.
close_reason: Built, tested and verified in the running app; see CHANGELOG.md

title: Radio sheets: re-verify yearly and fill the gaps
description: CHU, BBC long wave, repeater tones, HF emergency nets and marine channel numbers beyond 16, 70 and 9 could not be verified from primary sources on 2026-11-15 and are left out or marked.

title: Maps: check exported GPX in other apps and against the schema
description: Drawn routes export as well-formed GPX 1.1 and re-import correctly, but were not opened in another application.

title: Documents: keep bold text and links when showing a Markdown document
description: The Markdown view is built from extracted plain text, so emphasis and link text are dropped. Tables are shown.

title: Settings: controls for hybrid ranking (fusion constant and weights)
description: search.hybrid.rrfK, keywordWeight and semanticWeight can only be changed through the API. The How search works page lets them be tried but not saved.

title: Catalogue: add CDC, FEMA and Project Gutenberg direct entries once their hosts can be read
description: On 2026-11-15 cdc.gov, fema.gov and gutenberg.org answered the catalogue check with 403, so nothing there was verified. See docs/sources.md.

title: Maps: drag saved places directly on the map
description: A saved place must be opened before its pin can be dragged; other places are plain map dots.

title: Notes: virtualise the page tree and allow touch drag and drop
description: The tree renders every row (3,000 pages in one branch expands in about 0.4 s). Drag and drop is HTML5 only, so touch devices use Move to.

title: Maps: edge handles and keyboard adjustment for the download box
description: The region box is adjusted by its four corners only. Add edge handles and arrow-key nudging. Found during the Maps screen build.

title: Contour lines and richer topographic layers
description: Hill shading exists when terrain is downloaded; contours need a contour tileset or client-side generation.

title: Ship a local embedding model option in the packaged app
description: The in-process provider needs @huggingface/transformers, which is not bundled. Consider an image variant or a download-on-demand runtime.

title: OCR for scanned PDFs and images
description: Optional, off by default. Provider interface plus Tesseract with locally supplied language data. Scanned documents are currently stored and viewable but not searchable.

title: Phase 6: Future AI interfaces
description: Documented interfaces for retrieval, reranking, context assembly, model providers and citations. No LLM in the initial release.

title: Notes: block handle for single list items
description: The grip works on top-level blocks only.

title: Merge changes from a portable drive back into the main library
description: Today a drive is a copy; notes written while travelling stay on the drive.

title: PostgreSQL and pgvector back end
description: Fill in the VectorIndex seam and a Postgres search adapter for larger deployments.
